name: levels/level-1-domain-mismatch
description: Negative fixture: the DOMAIN_VERIFIED AgentCard served from provider.url https://example.com, with a matching domain attestation and a valid DNS TXT record at _a2a-identity.example.com, but an agentId that claims a different domain (urn:a2a:agent:example.org:financial-advisor:v2). The agentId is a well-formed URN and the record's agent name, kid, and fingerprint all match. A conforming verifier MUST reject: the domain that endorsed the key is not the domain the agent identifier claims. Models an agent asserting an identifier under a domain it does not control while presenting another domain's record.

spec.section: §1 Agent Identity Verification Levels — Level 1 DNS Verification (agentId domain binding)
